hero.tagline:
A mechanician’s atelier 
for materials engineering.
hero.introduction: We are experimenters who build instruments and take measurements, fueling material informatics to design tomorrow’s materials—from aerospace, healthcare to quantum technologies.

purpose.heading:
Theory inspires experiment.
Experiment challenges theory.
purpose.paragraph_one: We build instruments, design experiments, and use X-rays to generate multiscale—from atomistic to continuum—and multimodal datasets of complex material behavior through full-field measurements.
purpose.paragraph_two: These measurements fuel materials informatics, enable AI for materials design, and advance Physical AI for the next generation of experiments.

research_streams.title:
Physical AI
for Mechanics
research_streams.description: Can a machine autonomously interrogate a material until it understands its behavior? We close the loop between making, measuring, learning and choosing the next experiment.

research_streams.title:
Mechanical
metamaterials
research_streams.description: We use architecture to program stiffness, strength, deformation and failure—turning geometry and controlled defects into material design variables.

research_streams.title:
Thermodynamic
metamaterials
research_streams.description: We design topology, interfaces and transport pathways so structures become thermal devices, from compact heat exchangers to multifunctional aerospace systems.

projects.title: Ripstop gyroids
projects.description: Interpenetrating networks create reinforced regions designed to interrupt crack propagation and produce architected damage tolerance.

projects.title: Architected heat exchangers
projects.description: Additively manufactured structures use geometry to increase transport efficiency while reducing size and mass.

projects.title: Stress–strain, everywhere
projects.description: Optical full-field imaging and X-ray scattering reveal local elastic, plastic and total strain response in spatially heterogeneous materials.

contact.description: Studio is a materials design and experimental mechanics group at Caltech.
